changeSet.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts account SET status = 'REJECTED', is_default = FALSE, verified_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 'liquibase' WHERE account.status != 'DISABLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payouts payout WHERE payout.bank_account_id = account.bank_account_id AND payout.status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND ( LOWER(COALESCE(payout.failure_code, '')) LIKE '%account_not_found%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(payout.failure_code, '')) LIKE '%invalid_account%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(payout.failure_code, '')) LIKE '%destination_account%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(payout.failure_reason, '')) LIKE '%tài khoản nhận%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(payout.failure_reason, '')) LIKE '%tai khoan nhan%' ) );
